stories.headline: Trumbull Arts Festival postponed to Oct. 11 after nor’easter advisory
stories.summary: Town officials said Friday the Trumbull Arts Festival, planned for Sunday on the Town Hall Green, has been rescheduled to Oct. 11 under advice from Trumbull Emergency Management. A hazardous-weather outlook for a powerful weekend nor’easter prompted the delay; the event still invites residents to support local art and live entertainment when it returns.

stories.headline: Supreme Court clears Trump admin to use modified SAVE voter-citizenship database
stories.summary: In an unsigned Friday opinion 39 days before the Nov. 3 midterms, the justices paused a D.C. district-court block on DHS’s expanded SAVE system, which taps Social Security data for state voter-citizenship checks. The majority said challengers’ privacy claims likely lack merit; Justices Jackson, Sotomayor, and Kagan dissented, warning of harms to lawful voters even as systematic purges remain barred within 90 days of an election.

stories.headline: Trump books Mobile midterm rally Oct. 2 at USA Mitchell Center
stories.summary: President Trump will hold a Trump 47 Committee midterm rally Friday, Oct. 2, at the University of South Alabama’s Mitchell Center in Mobile. Doors open at 3:30 p.m. with the program at 6 p.m.; attendees must RSVP. The stop pairs with a Durant, Oklahoma, rally the day before as the White House returns to the trail after the Xi state visit.

stories.headline: WSHU: Did masked ICE agents break Connecticut’s TRUST Act at Meriden courthouse?
stories.summary: Connecticut’s TRUST Act bars ICE from wearing masks and from courthouse arrests without a warrant — rules activists say agents flouted Wednesday in Meriden. Gov. Ned Lamont told reporters the agents lacked a warrant; ICE said it arrested a man with a 2023 removal order after a DUI court date and accused marshals of impeding the arrest. Two activists were hurt in the clash.

stories.headline: iPad mini 8 leak: A20 Pro chip, landscape front camera, new speakers
stories.summary: Apple code spotted by MacRumors shows the next iPad mini with an A20 Pro chip, a landscape FaceTime camera (the last iPad to make the switch), and a speaker cutout groove atop the glass. The icons align with Mark Gurman’s water-resistance and vibration-speaker reports; an OLED bump and late-October launch remain the working rumor.

stories.headline: Apple TV 4K (4th gen) image surfaces — A17 Pro, 8GB RAM, Wi-Fi 7 rumored
stories.summary: MacRumors found Apple’s own “Apple TV 4K (4th generation)” product image, ending a nearly four-year wait since the A15 model. Specs are still rumor-tier — A17 Pro or newer, 8GB RAM for Siri AI, N1 Wi-Fi 7/Bluetooth 6, and a revised Siri Remote — with the same black-box shell and an October announcement window in play after June’s price hike to $199/$249.

stories.headline: LEGO Astro Bot GWP revealed: 276 pieces, swappable eyes — tied to PlayStation set
stories.summary: LEGO’s official store page confirms the 18+ Astro Bot set: 276 pieces, about eight inches tall, with dynamic posing and swappable eyes. It’s a gift-with-purchase, not a standalone buy — likely paired with the $179.99 PlayStation set or a ~$150 cart — launching Oct. 1 for Insiders and Oct. 4 for everyone alongside the console diorama set.

stories.headline: Jets: Adonai Mitchell limited with finger snag; Shepard or Johnson likely elevated
stories.summary: Ahead of Sunday at Detroit, Aaron Glenn said Adonai Mitchell will be limited again after catching a finger in a jersey Thursday — Glenn doesn’t think it’s broken but stayed coy on Week 3 availability. Mitchell has nine catches for 123 yards; Glenn also said either Tyler Johnson or Sterling Shepard will be elevated from the practice squad with Mason Taylor doubtful.

stories.headline: CT nor’easter: Wind Advisory and coastal flood warnings through Sunday
stories.summary: A Wind Advisory covers all of Connecticut Friday afternoon through Sunday morning, with gusts over 50 mph possible especially along the shore. Coastal Flood Advisories and Warnings flag minor-to-moderate inundation at high tides Friday evening through Sunday morning as rain arrives late Friday and lingers into Monday — the same system that pushed Trumbull to postpone Sunday’s Arts Festival.

stories.headline: Trumbull boys soccer’s unbeaten run ends 1–0 at Ridgefield; Stamford next Saturday
stories.summary: Trumbull fell 1–0 to Ridgefield on Thursday, its first loss after opening 4–0–1 against the Tigers’ tight defense. Ridgefield improved to 4–0–1; the Eagles host conference foe Stamford at 11:15 a.m. Saturday while Ridgefield faces Ludlowe at 10 a.m.
